verdict: Both confirmed findings resolved for the bounded unpaid helper scope
scope: Working-tree delta of the unpaid stall probe and its seven narrow regression cases against bae6d19; no whole review rerun or live infrastructure verification

findings.evidence: docker create cannot launch a process. The returned full64hex ID, image, allocation and role labels are validated while stopped, then stored in roles before docker start. Accepted start timeout reaches the existing identity-checked finally stop using the retained full ID; an ambiguous create can leave a stopped unacknowledged container but never launches it.

CountingTransport now counts GET and POST effects. _verify_stopped_reopen snapshots the full dictionary, requires intervention_status=stopped and rejects any counter change after reopening. It rejects a returned result, fencing_uncertain, resend-then-stopped and GET-then-stopped.

validation.exact_old_source_negative_control: Both launch cleanup cases fail against exact bae6d19 main with Docker API acceptance followed by timeout: running container remains outside recorded roles.
validation.transport_guard_mutation: Removing the post-reopen equality condition causes both GET and diagnostic mutation cases to fail with DID NOT RAISE.
validation.stopped_status_mutation: Removing the stopped-status condition causes the fencing_uncertain case to fail with DID NOT RAISE.

limits: Fault tests model Docker API create/start acceptance and failure ordering; no live Docker timeout was injected.
Ambiguous docker create may retain an unidentified stopped container. No automatic adoption, restart or deletion is introduced.
Cleanup still relies on a responsive trusted Docker daemon; this helper is not production isolation or gateway proof.
Root owns the fresh fixed-source live unpaid probe and its final actual receipts. This review made no assertion that it already passed.
